entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Okay, I can definitely look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number to start?
Thank you, Sarah. I see your order for the Velo-Pro Helmet. To make sure I'm helping you correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a preference, I guess. The color is just not what I thought it would be.

I understand completely. Getting the right color for a new helmet is important, not just for style but for visibility and safety on the road. Can you confirm if the item is still in its original packaging?
Yes, the box is unopened. I knew as soon as I saw it.
Perfect. Thank you for clarifying that. I see here that the helmet was delivered just three days ago, which is unfortunately outside our 10-day return policy for apparel and gear.
Great. So what do I do?

I'm processing the return for you right now. I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email we have on file for you. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and you can drop it off at any postal service location. Once we receive it, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method.
Excellent. You should see that email in your inbox shortly. Is there anything else I can help you with today, Sarah?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. We appreciate your business and hope you have a great day.
